current_point.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用"领导-工作者"工作模式，通过基于边分割的图流划分算法将原图划分为子图分配给各工作节点，工作节点执行基于图摘要的小批量训练，并由领导节点汇总结果计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型，从而大幅加速GNN训练。
current_point.claim_en: Propose DSGNN, a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm based on graph summarization, which adopts a "leader-worker" mode, uses a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation to divide the original graph into subgraphs assigned to workers, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization, and the leader summarizes results to compute gradients and synchronously update models on all computing nodes, greatly accelerating GNN training.
technical_features: 采用领导-工作者工作模式，由领导节点负责图划分和梯度汇总
使用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: adopt a leader-worker mode where the leader node is responsible for graph partition and gradient aggregation
use a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation to divide the original graph
workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
the leader summarizes results, calculates gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes
